description: This file defines the CommandUsageRepository class, which manages database operations related to command usage records, including CRUD operations and search functionality.

classes.name: CommandUsageRepository
classes.description: Repository class for managing command usage data in the database, including methods for finding, inserting, updating, and deleting command usage records.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Retrieves a command usage record by its ID, including the creator's full name.

methods.name: findByCommandId
methods.description: Retrieves all command usage records associated with a specific command ID.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs a search for command usage records based on search criteria, ordered by name.

methods.name: getBaseSelectQueryBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new base SelectQueryBuilder instance for command_usage table.

methods.name: deleteById
methods.description: Deletes a command usage record by its ID.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a new command usage record into the database.

methods.name: updateById
methods.description: Updates a command usage record identified by its ID with new column values.
